mcp_tools.name: production_python_engineering_pack_expert
mcp_tools.title: Production python engineering pack expert
mcp_tools.description: Submits an expert production Python engineering record (expert typing and idioms, expert packaging, expert async, expert performance with declared hot-path rows, expert surfaces, expert testing, red lines) and returns a deterministic PRODUCTION_PYTHON_ENGINEERING_PACK_EXPERT_READY / PRODUCTION_PYTHON_ENGINEERING_PACK_EXPERT_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including computed hot-path profiling-first and acceleration-route checks over the declared rows, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared engineering record only; it runs no code and profiles nothing.

inputSchema.description: The production python engineering pack expert manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

expect.notes: All fields present and valid. Computed hot_paths_count = 1, profiled_first_coverage = 1.000000, skill_route_coverage = 1.000000.
